run_low_shot_logistic_regression: run low-shot logistic regression benchmark on extracted features with configurable lambda values
run_low_shot_svm: run low-shot SVM classification benchmark on extracted features from a specified model layer
run_low_shot_all_layers: run low-shot benchmark across all model trunk output feature layers and return per-layer top-1 scores
extract_features_and_low_shot: extract model features and run low-shot benchmarks with optional multi-seed averaging
extract_features_and_low_shot_on_slurm: submit a resumable low-shot benchmark job to a SLURM cluster via submitit
